query:
SELECT
               si.quantity,
               si.unit_price,
               si.discount,
               si.subtotal,
               p.name AS product_name,
               v.sku,
               v.attributes as "attributes!: serde_json::Value"
           FROM sale_items si
           JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.variant_id
           JOIN products p ON p.id = v.product_id
           WHERE si.sale_id = $1
           ORDER BY si.id ASC
